"import csv
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN

# ---- 1. Read and parse the CSV ----
rows = []
with open('load_02.csv', 'r', newline='') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    fieldnames = [fn.strip() for fn in reader.fieldnames]
    for raw in reader:
        rec = {fn.strip(): (raw[fn.strip()] if fn.strip() in raw else raw.get(fn, '')) for fn in fieldnames}
        rows.append(rec)

# Helper to find a column by candidate names
def find_col(candidates):
    for c in fieldnames:
        for cand in candidates:
            if c.lower() == cand.lower():
                return c
    return None

case_col    = find_col(['case', 'case_id', 'specimen', 'id', 'name'])
load_col    = find_col(['load_factor', 'load', 'load_factor_max', 'peak_load', 'stress'])
cycles_col  = find_col(['cycles', 'n_cycles', 'cycle_count', 'count'])

# Extract numeric values
cases = []
loads = []
cycles = []
for r in rows:
    cases.append(r[case_col])
    try:
        loads.append(float(r[load_col]))
    except Exception:
        # try stripped numeric
        loads.append(float(str(r[load_col]).strip()))
    try:
        cycles.append(int(float(r[cycles_col])))
    except Exception:
        cycles.append(int(float(str(r[cycles_col]).strip())))

# ---- 2. Compute statistics ----
n_cases      = len(rows)
load_max     = max(loads)
load_mean    = sum(loads) / len(loads)
total_cycles = sum(cycles)

# Rounded display values (per spec)
n_cases_disp      = n_cases                       # exact
load_max_disp     = round(load_max, 2)            # 2.39
load_mean_disp    = round(load_mean, 2)           # 1.69
total_cycles_disp = total_cycles                  # exact

# ---- 3. Build the presentation ----
prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width  = Inches(13.333)
prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)
blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]

def add_title(slide, text, size=36, top=Inches(0.5)):
    tb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.6), top, Inches(12), Inches(1.0))
    tf = tb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.LEFT
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.bold = True
    return tb

def add_bullets(slide, lines, top=Inches(2.0), size=22):
    tb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), top, Inches(12), Inches(5.0))
    tf = tb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        p = tf.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()
        run = p.add_run()
        run.text = f"• {line}"
        run.font.size = Pt(size)
    return tb

# --- Slide 1: Title ---
s1 = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
add_title(s1, "Engineering Test Briefing — Load Factor & Cycles", size=40, top=Inches(2.5))
sub = s1.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.6), Inches(3.8), Inches(12), Inches(1.2))
p = sub.text_frame.paragraphs[0]
r = p.add_run()
r.text = "Data-anchored summary of fatigue test cases"
r.font.size = Pt(22)

# --- Slide 2: Data (one table) ---
s2 = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
add_title(s2, "Data", size=32, top=Inches(0.3))

header = ['case', 'load_factor', 'cycles']
data_rows = [[str(c), f"{loads[i]:g}", str(cycles[i])] for i, c in enumerate(cases)]

n_rows = len(data_rows) + 1
n_cols = len(header)
left   = Inches(0.6)
top    = Inches(1.4)
width  = Inches(6.0)
height = Inches(5.6)
table_shape = s2.shapes.add_table(n_rows, n_cols, left, top, width, height)
table = table_shape.table

# Header
for j, h in enumerate(header):
    cell = table.cell(0, j)
    cell.text = h
    for para in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
        for run in para.runs:
            run.font.bold = True
            run.font.size = Pt(14)

# Body
for i, row in enumerate(data_rows, start=1):
    for j, val in enumerate(row):
        cell = table.cell(i, j)
        cell.text = val
        for para in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            for run in para.runs:
                run.font.size = Pt(12)

# --- Slide 3: Summary ---
s3 = prs.slide"
